reuse.why: Introduces shared guard helpers, but the Fintegra link is a sixth hand copy of the per-provider link body instead of a shared link core, the holder unlink re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset rather than extracting it, and linkFintegraAccount repeats the upgrading-account lookup that ensureAccountCanBeLinked just did.

duplication.why: Copies the full link body (bank lookup, update-or-insert account, payee, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, sync-event), the unlink field reset, the Akahu-style download function and balance branch, and pastes the same two-call guard preamble into six link functions.

placement.why: Provider plumbing lands in the expected places (server-config, sync.ts, app.ts handlers), but the link preconditions are repeated inside each provider function rather than in one wrapper, and a guard named 'ensure not linked' performs the unlink mutation.

scope.why: Changes serve the four steps; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to every provider is a small extra edit.

maintainability.why: Any future link rule must be added to six provider functions, and ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked now mixes a check with a write behind a boolean flag.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked clears the holder with its own copy of unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount reset; linkFintegraAccount re-queries and re-checks the upgrading account already validated by ensureAccountCanBeLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (Fintegra link body, unlink reset, download function, balance branch) are written openly in the same shape as their originals.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains a replaceExistingLink flag and a branch that turns the refusal into an inline unlink; linkFintegraAccount re-implements the upgrading-account lookup/not-found check that ensureAccountCanBeLinked performs.
